Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 1). CIMT is also managing the 
Gold Mountain incident. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Active fire behavior 
with uphill runs, backing and torching. Residences threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, 
brush and timber. Moderate fire behavior with uphill runs, backing and torching. Numerous structures and 
critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Rio Blanco, San Juan NF, USFS. Ten miles south of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber, brush and grass. 
Moderate fire behavior with short-range spotting and uphill runs. Numerous structures threatened. 
Evacuations, area and road closures in effect. 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. Transfer of command from CIMT (RM Team 3) back to the local unit occurred 
yesterday. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with backing and creeping. 
Numerous structures and communication infrastructure threatened. Area and road closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior. Area, road and trail closures in effect.
